notes: Personally read all 50 original gold-blinded reports in five groups of ten and reasoned all 600 targets under the frozen rubric. No other 020 annotations, gold values, legacy labels, external labels, regex/NLI labeling or default filling accessed/used. Python only assembled explicit personal choices and validated exact contiguous original-language quotes, schema and UID coverage through rsna.labels.read_reviews. All unfinished work remained outside initiative. Explicit absence versus below-threshold findings distinguished in per-report notes; missing extent, severity, acuity, anatomy, side correspondence and contradictions remain uncertain where appropriate. Only completion/coverage/hashes shared with root; target-specific flags withheld for source-first independent review. This reader draft does not confer training eligibility or image diagnostic accuracy.
